senses.gloss: निच्छिवि ni-cchivi, m. a mixed caste (offspring 🞄of Vrātya Kṣatriya).

नीचा nīc-ā́, ad. (in. of nyañc) below;
 down.
नीचावगाह nīca‿avagāha, a. bathed in by 🞄low persons (lake).
नीचावयस् nīcā-vayas, a. whose vigour is 🞄low, exhausted.
नीचीन nīc-ī́na, a. downward: -bāra, a. 🞄having the aperture downward.
नीचैराख्य nīcair-ākhya, a. named ‘Low’ 🞄(mountain, i. e. nīcair-giri).
